repos_data.description: A modern Python library for SLURM workload manager integration with workflow orchestration capabilities.

Official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server to search, filter, and retrieve live remote job listings from the Jobicy database in real-time. Works with Claude Code, Cursor, Cline, and custom AI agents.
An extremely easy way to perform background processing in Java. Backed by persistent storage. Open and free for commercial use.
Simple in-memory job queue for Golang using worker-based dispatching

Self-hostable workflow orchestrator for teams whose main work isn't orchestration. Declarative YAML over your scripts, SSH commands, containers, etc; keep workflows separate from business logic. One binary, no database, runs on limited H/W resources. Alternative to Airflow / Cron / Job Scheduler.
Easy C# API for Distributed Background Tasks/Jobs for .NET Core.
Infrastructure access broker for AI agents — SSH & Kubernetes. Per-operation ephemeral credentials minted by a separate signer; the model never touches one. MCP stdio / HTTP+OIDC.

repo_meta_data.description: Self-hostable GPU-aware job broker for your own machines, with native MCP/agent integration
